fufu 0.16.1 is a patch release with one fix.

## Fixes

- [`ff push`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/push/) of a branch that is not checked out no longer overwrites that branch's parked work with the current checkout's tree. Work already affected is recovered from a retained pre-push capture; the [stacked-branch guide](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/guides/stacked-changes/#inspect-local-work-after-a-named-push) shows how.
